## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `perf`: Performance optimization
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation or examples update
- [ ] `ci` / `chore`: Build, CI/CD, or maintenance

## Checklist

- [ ] Code is formatted (`make fmt`) and passes static analysis (`make vet`)
- [ ] All unit and integration tests pass with the race detector (`make race`)
- [ ] Example configurations validate cleanly (`make validate`)
- [ ] Documentation (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `examples/`) has been updated if user-facing behavior changed
